name: Create a Redundancy Group
description: Create a Redundancy Group Creates a new redundancy group, optionally with tunnel members. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/redundancy_groups
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/redundancy_groups
Creates a new redundancy group, optionally with tunnel members.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete a Redundancy Group
description: Delete a Redundancy Group Deletes a redundancy group. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/redundancy_groups/{redundancy_group_id}

name: Get Redundancy Group Details
description: Get Redundancy Group Details Gets details for a specific redundancy group, including full member tunnel data. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/redundancy_groups/{redundancy_group_id}

name: List Redundancy Groups
description: List Redundancy Groups Lists redundancy groups associated with an account, including full member tunnel data. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/redundancy_groups
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/redundancy_groups
Lists redundancy groups associated with an account, including full member tunnel data.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Update a Redundancy Group
description: Update a Redundancy Group Replaces the name, description, and full set of members for an existing redundancy group. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/magic/redundancy_groups/{redundancy_group_id}
